research_question: Does local Qwen3-8B reach the individual-reasoning gate on the official full-profile controls, and how much does its group accuracy change after the official hidden-profile discussion on the three verification tasks?

model.name: Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M
model.runtime: llama.cpp b11202; 99 GPU layers; one slot; context 4096; batch 1024; micro-batch 256

design.retry_policy: The upstream client retries failed API requests up to three times. Invalid vote responses can also trigger up to three vote-level attempts, each invoking that client. Thus 408 is the nominal number of successful responses, not a hard cap on server requests; count all attempts and completions from server logs and report any deviation.
design.capability_gate: Report Full Profile pre-discussion average answer accuracy. If it is below 0.8, treat this as an individual capability/adapter limitation and do not rank communication protocols on this model/task sample.

primary_outcomes: Full Profile pre-discussion average and majority accuracy
Hidden Profile pre-discussion and post-discussion average and majority accuracy
all decoded message and prompt token usage available from llama.cpp logs, cache-aware service timing, and serialized discussion wire-token counts
analysis: Use official HiddenBench scoring. Report each task and both aggregation rules; the three-task summary is descriptive. A high Full Profile score with low Hidden Profile pre-score validates the hidden-information split for this local setup. Any hidden-profile pre/post difference is a discussion effect only. Do not make protocol, generalization, scaling, efficiency-frontier, or universal necessity claims.
limits: Three related tasks, one model, one task seed, one run per profile.
This calibration does not compare message encodings or enforce a fixed communication budget.
OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp usage and prompt KV-cache reuse must be accounted for separately from client input token estimates.
The JSON-mode adapter may fail or retry; report actual request attempts/completions and preserve partial traces.
